Method of Attack: Malware downloader assembling infected computers into a botnet
Downloading malicious files from a command and control server
Self-spreading via removable USB storage, Skype, Windows Live Messenger (earlier variants)
Email spam as main delivery and infection mechanism
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected by Trik trojan and GandCrab ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control server located on a Russian IP address
Leaked server containing 2201 text files with over 43 million unique email addresses
Email addresses database used for malspam campaigns
Intermittent offline status of Trik C&C server
